provider: TG-FileStreamBot / filestream.bot — HTTP stream front-end over Telegram files

free_tier.stated: Inherits Telegram's unlimited storage but solves a different problem: turning a stored Telegram file into a plain HTTP URL that a browser, VLC, or a download manager can range-request. 1,933 stars, pushed 2026-03-07, actively maintained.

retention.stated: Inherits Telegram's unlimited storage but solves a different problem: turning a stored Telegram file into a plain HTTP URL that a browser, VLC, or a download manager can range-request

egress.terms: Free from Telegram, served as HTTP from your host — so Cloudflare-cacheable. Multi-bot load balancing is the advertised scaling lever.

tooling: Go backend, multi-bot workers. The hosted filestream.bot instance describes the architecture plainly: 'Parallel block downloads with configurable concurrency. Prefetch buffers ensure smooth, uninterrupted playback' and 'Distribute API load across up to 50 bot tokens. Round-robin routing prevents rate limiting.' Same family as TheCaduceus/FileStreamBot (134 stars, 2024) and SpringsFern/tgfilestream.
chaining: 50 bot tokens x their own per-account flood budgets = roughly 50x the single-account download concurrency, which is the only lever that moves Telegram read throughput.
limits_note: Bot-token based, so 20 MB per file via cloud Bot API unless you run the local Bot API server. It streams; it does not cache, so every viewer GET is a Telegram pull unless you add a CDN.

reliability_note: Maintained and the streaming model is sound. The failure mode is a hot file: N concurrent viewers on one file means N independent Telegram pulls, which will hit FLOOD_WAIT quickly without an edge cache.
